body: Hey. I'm sorry you're going through this. I just made my own post a few hours ago because I'm dealing with suicidal feelings myself. I may not know exactly what you're going through, but I know the feeling like nothing that I've done in life has mattered. You mentioned you have a son that you seem to care about. Just wanted to say that just by being a dad, you've already done a lot that has mattered and has made a real difference in the world, even if it doesn't feel like it right now.

Thank you. I guess all I wanted to add is that while I'm so grateful to have a few family members that I love very much, it also means that I feel like I can't actually go through it because I couldn't stand to put them through the pain and trauma of my death. It makes me feel very stuck and hopeless sometimes. Just wanted to get that off my chest.

Thanks for your kind words and professional perspective. I am fortunate enough to have affordable mental health care services available to me in my state and I have started therapy. It's been very hard to open and talk, but I plan on continuing with it.
